title.zh: vLLM-Omni 发布：简单、高效的全模态模型服务
title.en: Announcing vLLM-Omni: Easy, Fast, and Cheap Omni-Modality Model Serving

description.zh: 官方介绍全模态服务的目标、异构模型流水线和分阶段资源配置，并提供入门入口。
description.en: The official introduction to omni-modal serving, heterogeneous model pipelines and stage-level resource allocation, with links to get started.

author: vLLM-Omni Team
sourceNote: Title, byline, publication date and technical scope verified on the original official article. Covers motivation, architecture, key features and getting started; roadmap items are not asserted as completed features.

title.zh: 走进 vLLM-Omni 架构：服务 Qwen3-Omni

description.zh: 通过保险理赔演示理解 Thinker、Talker、Code2Wav 三阶段服务、OmniConnector 和流式流水线。
description.en: An insurance-claim demo explains the Thinker, Talker and Code2Wav stages, OmniConnector transport and streaming pipeline execution.

author: Isaac Tigges
sourceNote: Title, byline, publication date and technical scope verified on the original Red Hat Developer article. This is a complete written architecture walkthrough with a companion video; the article date and byline describe the article.

title.zh: Qwen3-Omni 多阶段服务：实践经验与性能优化
title.en: Experience and Lessons Learned from Serving Multi-Stage Qwen3-Omni in vLLM-Omni

description.zh: 逐阶段讲解批处理、CUDA Graph、异步分块、异步输出和副本扩容，并提供受控测试结果。
description.en: A stage-by-stage walkthrough of batching, CUDA Graphs, async chunking, async output and replica scaling, supported by controlled benchmarks.

author: vLLM-Omni Team and Ant Group SCT Team
sourceNote: Title, byline, publication date and optimization chapters verified on the original official article. The summary describes mechanisms and controlled validation without generalizing measured speedups across configurations.

title.zh: vLLM-Omni 快速入门：离线推理与在线服务
title.en: vLLM-Omni Quickstart: Offline Inference and Online Serving

description.en: Set up the environment, run offline image generation and launch online serving through an OpenAI-compatible API.

sourceNote: Topic, installation steps, offline image-generation examples and online-serving examples verified on the project-maintained guide. This is a continuously updated latest document; no publication date or individual author is asserted.

title.zh: vLLM AFD Plugin 发布：分离 Attention 与 FFN

description.en: An introduction to the experimental AFD plugin, its Attention and FFN services, connector interface, GPU/NPU support and deployment recipes.

author: AFD Plugin Contributors
sourceNote: Title, byline, publication date, architecture and deployment sections verified on the original official article. The article explicitly calls the plugin experimental and limits support claims to validated configurations.

author: vLLM Team
sourceNote: Title, byline, publication date and technical scope verified on the original official article. Its repository link identifies vllm-project/router, distinct from vLLM Semantic Router. No benchmark numbers are generalized in the catalog summary.

description.zh: 比较一致性哈希、二选一、缓存感知和 KV 感知等策略，学习会话亲和与路由配置。

sourceNote: Verified as the complete project-maintained load-balancing guide, including six routing policies, session-affinity key priorities and configuration examples. description.en: A community walkthrough of step-level scheduling, dynamic batching, mixed-resolution execution and the mechanisms and limits of PiD.
